name: wordpress
description: Owner-managed, isolated WordPress sites for repeatable forms, commerce, and content delivery work.

hostTools.name: docker
hostTools.reason: WordPress, MariaDB and WP-CLI are separate owner-managed containers.

instances.rationale: Per-site database and WordPress content are durable until that exact owner instance is reset or removed.

snapshots.rationale: WordPress snapshots are explicit recovery and review evidence; reset never removes them.

linux.reason: A desktop-bundled Docker daemon and container lifecycle contract are not defined.
limitations: A task-scoped WordPress runtime depends on the control-plane Docker lifecycle; no desktop bundle or installer exists.
